name: Beg
sum: Beg is the most basal known neoceratopsian, from the Ulaanoosh Formation of Mongolia, known from a partial skull.
wsnote: No size given in the sources used.
holotype: IGM 100/3652, a partial skull with fragmentary postcrania (a rib, partial left scapula, partial right ischium) — Ulaanoosh Formation, near Tsogt-Ovoo, Ömnögovi, Mongolia.
biology: Shows transitional features between basal ceratopsians and other neoceratopsians; rugose structures on the jugal.
author: Yu et al. 2020

sources.text: Yu, C., Prieto-Márquez, A., Chinzorig, T., Badamkhatan, Z., Norell, M. 2020. A neoceratopsian dinosaur from the early Cretaceous of Mongolia and the early evolution of Ceratopsia. Communications Biology 3: 499. doi:10.1038/s42003-020-01222-7.
